fieldValues.title: One decision
fieldValues.article_text: The decision fits in one sentence in the active voice: "We will…" or "We agree…". If it contains "and", try splitting it. Anything decided by default alongside it is named on its own line, never left as "decided unless you object" in the prose. Checked by: judgement, with a mechanical test that a resolution sentence exists.
fieldValues.rationale: From the owner's meeting review, where one of seven records held a single decision. An ask written only as a question leaves nothing to read back.
